title: Host Accounts Programme Benefits: Listings, Co-Hosts and Support
content:
# Host Accounts — Capacity and Support by Host Tier

| Host tier | Most live (listed or snoozed) listings | Co-host seats | Named account manager | Priority host support line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | 3 | 1 | No | No |
| Standard Host | 10 | 3 | No | No |
| Superhost | 10 | 5 | No | Yes |
| Professional Host | 50 | 10 | Yes | Yes |
| Professional Host Plus | 250 | 25 | Yes | Yes |
| Enterprise Partner | 2000 | 50 | Yes | Yes |

## Account closure (all tiers)

In every host tier, an account that has stays requested, confirmed or checked in cannot be closed.

## Notes

- "Live" counts listed and snoozed listings together; a snoozed listing uses a place in the limit just as a listed one does.
- A named account manager and the priority host support line are entitlements of the tier the account holds; Superhost carries priority support without a named account manager.
